title: Source concentration caps — Source-Diversity Controller (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. The source-diversity controller is the policy layer above diversity-aware ranking: it decides, per query, how much trust to place in each source and caps concentration before ranking begins. When one publisher dominates a topic, the controller throttles it and promotes alternatives, protecting answers from single-source bias, publisher outages, and quiet capture of the record. It keeps a live source registry with health, bias, and coverage statistics.

This record documents the source concentration caps approach: Limit any single source to at most X% of delivered results per query, configurable per collection.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
demo:
# Source-Diversity Controller demo: concentration caps over a source registry.
SRCS={"pubA":{"share":0.70,"health":1.0},"pubB":{"share":0.15,"health":1.0},
      "pubC":{"share":0.10,"health":0.0},"pubD":{"share":0.05,"health":1.0}}
RESULTS=[("r%d"%i,"pubA") for i in range(14)]+[("r%d"%i,"pubB") for i in range(14,17)]+[("r17","pubD")]
def control(results,cap=0.5):
    counts={}; out=[]
    for rid,src in results:
        if SRCS[src]["health"]<=0: continue
        if counts.get(src,0)>=cap*len(results): continue
        counts[src]=counts.get(src,0)+1; out.append((rid,src))
    return out,counts
kept,counts=control(RESULTS)
print("kept",len(kept),"distribution",counts)
provenance: Signature-generated-completion: original Signature-authored content by the JAH system, clearly labeled, not a public record.

# Source-Diversity Controller demo: concentration caps over a source registry.
SRCS={"pubA":{"share":0.70,"health":1.0},"pubB":{"share":0.15,"health":1.0},
      "pubC":{"share":0.10,"health":0.0},"pubD":{"share":0.05,"health":1.0}}
RESULTS=[("r%d"%i,"pubA") for i in range(14)]+[("r%d"%i,"pubB") for i in range(14,17)]+[("r17","pubD")]
def control(results,cap=0.5):
    counts={}; out=[]
    for rid,src in results:
        if SRCS[src]["health"]<=0: continue
        if counts.get(src,0)>=cap*len(results): continue
        counts[src]=counts.get(src,0)+1; out.append((rid,src))
    return out,counts
kept,counts=control(RESULTS)
print("kept",len(kept),"distribution",counts)
